messages:
Jules Park: Heads-up — Private/VPC 2.2 GA is live internally and we're publishing the customer-facing telemetry policy update alongside it. This is mainly opt-in by default for air-gapped installs, opt-out for hosted Dedicated. More details below. :loudspeaker:
Aisha Khan: Thanks. Short summary for execs: GA = controls for residency + per-route audit logs + opt-in telemetry for on-prem. No forced telemetry for air-gapped customers. We'll emphasize privacy-first posture in external comms.
Diego Ramos: Security summary: Audit logs are schema-stable and can be exported to S3-compatible endpoints or local syslog. We added a signed-log proof header for tamper detection. HSM key rotation will now emit a rotation event to the Audit API. Note: rotation automation requires customer opt-in when using customer-managed HSMs.
Liam O.: Ops notes: rolling GA deploy lowers default telemetry retention to 14 days for non-enterprise customers; enterprise can request custom retention in contract. For Private installs, installer flag --telemetry=on|off controls the agent. Example: 
```
./installer --mode private --telemetry off --hash-check
```
Support: we will not enable outbound telemetry by default in air-gapped bundles.
Jules Park: Marketing/CSM ask: what language do we want in the customer email about telemetry? Short, clear. Proposed: "We collect minimal anonymous usage metrics to improve reliability; no customer data is transmitted without explicit opt-in." Thoughts?
Aisha Khan: Edit to: "We collect minimal operational metrics to maintain service health. No workspace data or model I/O leaves your network unless you opt in to telemetry or use hosted routes." Keep it simple.
Diego Ramos: Legal/Compliance note: SOC2-friendly logs export requires customers to prove access controls around the export bucket; we'll provide an example policy in the runbook. Also added retention change matrix.
Liam O.: Rollout schedule: staging tomorrow 06:00 UTC (1935203200), staged prod rollouts start next Monday 1935788400 in cohorts. Support playbook and rollback steps in the runbook folder.
support-bot: New runbook uploaded: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/private-vpc-2-2-telemetry (revision 1.0). Please review all sections under "Telemetry & Audit" by EOD Friday.
Jules Park: Action items: 1) Legal + Security — finalize customer-facing short text (Diego + Aisha) 2) Solutions + CSM — prepare upgrade offer template (Liam + marketing) 3) Eng — sanity-check installer flags and offline bundle (Diego + Liam). Ping here when done.
Aisha Khan: Great work team. We'll post a short announcement to customers after docs are live. :white_check_mark:
